hostname l3-c41
!
username admin privilege 15 secret 0 Example-Secret-1
!
vlan 10
 name sample-office
!
vlan 20
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 switchport trunk native vlan 10
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 20,10
 switchport mode trunk
 storm-control broadcast level pps 500
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
 switchport mode trunk
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan10
 description sample office
 ip address 192.0.2.2 255.255.255.128
 ip access-group ACL-3000 in
 ip ospf 1 area 0.0.0.0
 vrrp 10 ip 192.0.2.1
 vrrp 10 priority 100
 vrrp 10 preempt
 vrrp 10 timers advertise 1
 no shutdown
!
ip sla 1
 icmp-echo 192.0.2.126
 frequency 5
ip sla schedule 1 life forever start-time now
track 1 ip sla 1 reachability
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.126 track 1
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 198.51.100.41
 redistribute static route-map sample-policy subnets
!
time-range sample-hours
 periodic weekdays 8:00 to 18:00
!
ip access-list standard ACL-2000
 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127
!
ip access-list extended ACL-3000
 permit tcp 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 any eq 443 time-range sample-hours
 permit icmp any any 8 0
 permit ip any any
!
ip prefix-list sample-in seq 10 permit 198.51.100.0/24 le 28
!
route-map sample-policy permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list sample-in
 set tag 30
!
snmp-server community example-ro RO ACL-2000
!
banner motd #
sample notice: authorized use only
#
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 30
line vty 0 4
 access-class ACL-2000 in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 login local
 transport input ssh
!
end
